$comment: Every ML model the engine runs, in one place (electron/modelManifest.ts reads it). `id` is the folder under <userData>/models/ (the user's install) and, for a bundled model, under <resources>/models/ (scripts/fetchModels.cjs stages it, electron-builder ships it). `env` names the engine variables: PREMATION_<env>_USER_DIR (the user's install) and PREMATION_<env>_DIR (the bundled copy). `source` is `pinned` (the URLs and checksums below are the only accepted ones) or `user` (the person supplies the URL; a `url` below is a default, not a pin). A `sha256` of null means no checksum is known for that file today — none has been invented; such a file is checked only for being an ONNX protobuf of at least `minBytes`.

models.name: Object Matte (SlimSAM-77)
models.description: Segment-anything model behind one-click Roto subject selection. Bundled with the app; a different SAM-class pair can be installed over it.

models.name: Object Matte GPU encoder (SlimSAM-77, float)
models.description: The float export of the bundled Object Matte encoder, for the GPU: the bundled int8 pair runs on the CPU only (DirectML cannot build its integer-quantized graph). With this file installed the engine runs the frame encoder on the GPU (DirectML, Core ML or CUDA) and keeps the bundled decoder; without a GPU provider it is ignored. Downloaded on demand; the user may point it at another float SAM-class encoder.

models.name: Face landmarks (MediaPipe Face Mesh V2)
models.description: 478-point face mesh (with irises) for the Tracker's Face tracking: Google's Face Landmarks Detector V2 as ONNX, a 256×256 RGB crop in, landmarks in crop pixels out (native/engine/src/jobs/face_ort_ffi.cpp reads the input side from the model). Bundled with the app; pinned to an exact revision and checksum.

models.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
models.description: Monocular depth for Make 3D from Photo / Video. Downloaded on first use from a pinned Hugging Face revision; the checksum is verified before anything is installed.

models.name: Hand tracking (MediaPipe palm + hand landmarks)
models.description: Palm detector and hand landmarker for live performance input (OpenCV Zoo ONNX exports). Bundled with the app; both files are pinned to an exact revision and checksum.

models.name: Object Matte video tracking (SAM 2.1 tiny)
models.description: Segment Anything 2.1 (hiera-tiny) with its memory modules, for following a subject through a shot without drifting on occlusion (native/engine/src/jobs/sam2_track.cpp). Downloaded on demand from a pinned Hugging Face revision of the square-zero-labs ONNX export; every file's checksum is verified. Without it, Object Matte follows the subject with SlimSAM frame by frame.

models.name: Refine Edge matting (ViTMatte small)
models.description: Learned alpha matting for Refine Edge: hair, fur and soft edges worked out from the picture inside the brushed band (native/engine/src/jobs/vitmatte_ort_ffi.cpp, on the CPU). Downloaded on demand from a pinned Hugging Face revision of the Xenova ONNX export (int8); the checksum is verified. Without it, Refine Edge estimates the edge from the colours either side.
